flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui utils/Meta/System.ts (Court Batch Limit/Duration menu entries without a route), App.tsx (empty COURT block), pages/System/form/ParameterForm (generic parameter CRUD); ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/parameter/{Parameter,ParameterController}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase (only notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason), OcmsChangeOfProcessing/EligibilityService (blocks notices at court stage); ocmsadminprivateapi ToppanDownloadJob (RR3/DR3 to CPC). No weekly schedule, selection job or court application eligibility criteria code in the six repos
note: The story asks OCMS to maintain a schedule of notices per week and to select eligible notices automatically. No code for that was found: no schedule page, no weekly schedule storage, no selection job/cron, no court application eligibility criteria. Only the metadata menu entries 'Court Batch Limit' and 'Court Batch Duration' without a route (Meta/System.ts:18-19,147-154) and the generic parameter CRUD, which no court code reads, exist. The 'Fully paid' status is not backed by code in the six repos; it may be built elsewhere or not exist, needs confirmation. No relevant maintenance ticket. Parameter values in the DB (e.g. a court batch row) cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done based on the code in these six repos. Ask URA/the team in which repo the weekly schedule and court application notice selection were built, or mark as a gap

steps.step: Officer opens a screen to maintain the weekly schedule of notices for court application
steps.detail: The menu entries 'Court Batch Limit' and 'Court Batch Duration' exist only as metadata for the paths /system/court-batch-limit and /system/court-batch-duration (Meta/System.ts:18-19,52-53,147-154). No <Route> exists for either: the system block in App.tsx only holds parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason, schedule-public-holiday (App.tsx:375-500) and the '{/* COURT */}' block is empty (App.tsx:313). There is no schedule screen component.

steps.step: OCMS stores the schedule of the number of notices per week
steps.detail: Only a generic parameter CRUD exists (ocms_parameter: parameter_id, code, description, value; Parameter.java:19-45; POST /v1/parameterpatch in ParameterController.java:98; OCMS_SYSTEM_PARAMETER authorization at api-authorization.properties:166-167). It can hold a single number, but there is no schedule or week concept, and no code reads a parameter for court. The OcmsCourtCase entity only stores notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:18-32). Rows in the parameter table in the DB cannot verify from repo. Fit is Tidak ada code because a generic mechanism is not the schedule storage the story names.

steps.step: OCMS automatically runs the selection of notices for court application per the schedule
steps.detail: There is no court application selection job/cron in ocmsadminprivateapi (workflows: adminfee, agencies, autorevival, casvipvehicle, daily_reports, ..., plus, repccs, unclaimedreport; none holds court selection; cron-schedules-prod.properties has no court job). The only code that moves notices to the early court stage is ToppanDownloadJob: RR3 to CPC and DR3 to CPC (ToppanDownloadJob.java:409-410), part of the reminder letter flow, not a weekly selection.

steps.step: Selection uses pre-defined criteria that check the conditions of notices eligible for court application
steps.detail: There is no court application eligibility rule. The only court-stage check is the EligibilityService in Change Processing Stage, which rejects notices at court stage (CRT/CRC/CFI) with reason COURT_STAGE (EligibilityService.java:86-87, SystemConstant COURT_STAGES_ELIGIBILITY), so it is not a selection criterion for court application.

steps.step: The number of notices selected follows the figure in the weekly schedule
steps.detail: COURT_BATCH_LIMIT and COURT_BATCH_DURATION are used nowhere except the menu metadata (Meta/System.ts:18-19,52-53,147-154, Fsystemadmin.d.ts:26-27); grep COURT_BATCH in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi gives 0 results. No code limits the selection count.
